resources.string:
Turn this on, use WAEX as usual, and when something goes wrong, share a small report with the developers. It is off by default and stays on your phone until you share it.

Saved for up to 7 days: WAEX screens you open, which settings you change (never their values), WAEX crashes, and whether WAEX hooks started correctly in WhatsApp.

Never saved: chats, contacts, media, passwords or logs from other apps.
Adds the reasons Android recently closed WhatsApp (crash, freeze, low memory). Restart WhatsApp once after turning this on. Requires Android 11 or newer.
When you share, the report also includes your phone model, Android and app versions, and which WAEX features are on. Nothing is sent automatically. You choose the app and who receives it.
Nothing to share yet. Use WAEX for a while, then try again after the problem happens.
Could not create the report. Check your free storage and try again.
No app could accept the report. Try another app from the share menu.
Could not save this setting. Please try again.
This removes the problem data saved on your phone. Reports you already shared are not affected.
